//: Enterprise managed settings — pushed by MDM/GPO, cannot be overridden by user or project settings.json.
//paths: Windows: C:/Program Files/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json | macOS: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json | Linux/WSL: /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json
//endpoint: Replace OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT with the team collector (see deploy-templates ingress.grpc / ingress.http). For the HTTP ingress use OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf and port 4318.
//auth: When the collector requires a bearer token, either set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS=Authorization=Bearer%20<token> here, or point otelHeadersHelper at a script that prints {"Authorization":"Bearer <token>"} (re-run every ~29 min).
//privacy: Prompts, assistant responses, tool content and raw API bodies stay OFF. TOOL_DETAILS=1 un-redacts tool/skill/agent/MCP names, bash commands and file paths.
